headline: Navi Pillay awarded Nobel Peace Prize
standfirst: The former UN human rights chief is recognized for her work in international law.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: South African judge Navi Pillay has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Pillay chaired a UN commission that concluded Israel committed genocide in Gaza.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The committee is honoring her long career dedicated to promoting international law.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: The global response to the committee's decision and her continued legal advocacy.

caption:
Navi Pillay has been awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her work in international law.

The Nobel committee recognized Pillay for her lifelong commitment to human rights. This includes her recent role chairing the UN commission that investigated the conflict in Gaza.

Does this award change how you view the role of international law in global conflicts?
